description: Twelve reproducible seed tasks across six quantum domains. Difficulty is uncalibrated; not a frontier difficulty claim.

tasks.title: Finite-register phase estimation
tasks.prompt: Ideal quantum phase estimation uses three counting qubits and an exact eigenstate of U with eigenvalue exp(2*pi*i/3). Use the inverse QFT convention for which a phase phi is peaked at integer 8*phi. Return a JSON list of all eight probabilities P(y), y=0,...,7, with y interpreted in ordinary binary (no output bit reversal).
tasks.reference_method: Squared finite geometric sum for a length-8 Fourier transform.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Grover search with multiple marked states
tasks.prompt: A uniform superposition over 128 basis states has three marked states. Apply five ideal Grover iterations, each consisting of a marked-state phase flip followed by diffusion 2|s><s|-I. Return the total success probability as a JSON number.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Entropy of a noisy entangled state
tasks.prompt: Let rho = 0.6*|Phi+><Phi+| + 0.4*I_4/4, where |Phi+>=(|00>+|11>)/sqrt(2). Return [S(rho), S(rho_A), I(A:B)] in bits, using von Neumann entropy and I(A:B)=S(rho_A)+S(rho_B)-S(rho).
tasks.reference_method: rho eigenvalues are [0.7,0.1,0.1,0.1]; both marginals are I/2.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Partial-transpose entanglement
tasks.prompt: For rho = 0.7*|Psi-><Psi-|+0.3*I_4/4, |Psi->=(|01>-|10>)/sqrt(2), return [negativity, logarithmic_negativity]. Define negativity=(||rho^(T_B)||_1-1)/2 and logarithmic_negativity=log2(||rho^(T_B)||_1).
tasks.reference_method: Partial transpose has one eigenvalue (1-3p)/4 and three eigenvalues (1+p)/4.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Open transverse-field Ising chain
tasks.prompt: Four spin-1/2 sites have H=-sum_{j=0}^{2} Z_j Z_{j+1} - 0.7*sum_{j=0}^{3} X_j, with Pauli matrices of eigenvalues +/-1, open boundaries and units J=1. Return all 16 eigenvalues sorted in ascending order, including multiplicities.
tasks.reference_method: Exact dense diagonalization of the 16x16 Kronecker-product Hamiltonian.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Periodic antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chain
tasks.prompt: Four spin-1/2 sites have H=sum_{j=0}^{3} S_j dot S_{(j+1) mod 4}, with S=Pauli/2 and J=1. Each of the four ring edges appears once. Return all 16 eigenvalues sorted in ascending order, including multiplicities.
tasks.reference_method: Exact dense diagonalization with the S=Pauli/2 normalization.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Two-determinant variational subspace
tasks.prompt: In an orthonormal two-determinant basis, a projected electronic Hamiltonian (hartree) is [[-1.1,0.18],[0.18,-0.4]]. Return [ground_state_energy, probability_of_second_determinant_in_ground_state]. The energy is that of this projected Hamiltonian, with no additional nuclear constant.
tasks.reference_method: Analytic eigenpair of a real symmetric 2x2 matrix.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Correlated Hubbard dimer
tasks.prompt: The two-site Hubbard Hamiltonian is H=-t*sum_sigma(c†_(1,sigma)c_(2,sigma)+h.c.)+U*sum_i n_(i,up)n_(i,down), t=1, U=4, exactly two electrons, no extra constant. Return [ground_state_energy, total_double_occupancy], where total_double_occupancy=<n_(1,up)n_(1,down)+n_(2,up)n_(2,down)>.
tasks.reference_method: Singlet ground energy (U-sqrt(U^2+16t^2))/2; Hellmann-Feynman derivative gives double occupancy.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Logical error under majority decoding
tasks.prompt: An 11-qubit repetition code protects against independent Pauli X errors with probability p=0.13 on every qubit. Syndrome measurement is perfect and decoding uses majority vote. Return the logical X failure probability; do not include phase errors.
tasks.reference_method: Binomial upper tail from six through eleven flips.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Steane CSS syndrome conventions
tasks.prompt: Use the Steane CSS code with binary parity-check matrix H whose column j (j=1,...,7) is the three-bit binary representation of j, least-significant bit first. Z stabilizers diagnose X errors and X stabilizers diagnose Z errors. An X error occurs on qubit 3 and a Z error on qubit 5 (labels 1-based). Return [Z_stabilizer_syndrome, X_stabilizer_syndrome], each a list of three integer bits in row order. A bit is 1 for anticommutation.
tasks.reference_method: CSS syndromes are H*e_X and H*e_Z over GF(2).
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Exact minimum-SWAP routing
tasks.prompt: Logical qubits 0,1,2,3 initially occupy physical vertices 0,1,2,3 of the path 0--1--2--3. Execute CNOTs (0,3),(0,2),(1,3),(0,1) in that exact order. A CNOT is legal only between adjacent physical vertices, in either direction. Only adjacent SWAPs may change the mapping. Final mapping is unrestricted; CNOTs cannot be decomposed, bridged, cancelled, or reordered. Return the minimum total number of SWAPs as a JSON integer.
tasks.reference_method: Breadth-first search on mapping permutations and next-gate index; legal gates advance at zero cost.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.

tasks.title: Phase-polynomial normalization
tasks.prompt: A diagonal three-qubit circuit multiplies |x> by exp(i*pi/4*sum_j a_j*(m_j dot x mod 2)), where masks m are integers encoding nonzero three-bit vectors. The (mask,coefficient) terms are [(1,1),(3,3),(7,1),(3,6),(1,7),(5,-1),(7,2)]. Merge identical masks, reduce coefficients modulo 8 to integers 0..7, and remove zero coefficients. Return {"terms": [[mask,coefficient],...], "odd_terms": count}, sorting terms by mask. odd_terms counts odd coefficients in this fixed merged representation; it is NOT a claim of globally minimal T count.
tasks.reference_method: Coefficient aggregation modulo 8; this task fixes the representation and does not optimize over phase-polynomial identities.
tasks.provenance: Original, analytically or numerically constructed LastExam seed task; no external dataset copied.
